material.provenance: SAMPLE/material_template.txt lines 30-32: the 24-constant example block whose names, order and units are documented in lines 1-28 of the same file and which SUBROUTINE VSPRATE consumes in that order. Twenty-four values for the twenty-four PROPS indices this source addresses. INPUT_FILES/TEST_INDENT_UMAT.inp independently declares CONSTANTS=24 and DEPVAR 16 for this family. It is an upstream template-plus-example file rather than a deck card: SAMPLE/material_co.inp holds 26 values and is used for UMAT_VPDCO, which reads 26; truncating it to 24 here would be a transformation this pipeline does not perform. The strain path and DTIME are declared by the pipeline, not by upstream.

material.provenance: crystalplasticity/crystalplasticity.inp, the *User Material block for material U1 declaring constants=160, read in file order. The source addresses PROPS up to index 160 and no further, so the count matches exactly. The same deck declares *Depvar 172, which is why nstatv is 172 here and not the 21 this manifest previously carried: the source indexes STATEV(NSTATV-22), and 21 would address STATEV(-1). The strain path, increment count and DTIME are declared by this pipeline, not by upstream: every deck in the snapshot is a boundary-value problem rather than a material-point strain history.

User ELEMENT (UEL) library. Provides no SUBROUTINE UMAT, so it is discovered and classified but has no UMAT entry to transform.

AGPL crystal plasticity. Never fetched by setup and never executed here; listed so it stays in the denominator.

Abaqus-compatible UMATs published with the UMAT4COMSOL paper: neo-Hookean hyperelasticity, finite-strain elastoplasticity, and a crystal-plasticity model. Independently authored and not present in any other collection here, and the first finite-strain sources in the corpus.
